name: gtm-video-factory
description: Remotion-based video generator for Enterprise AI Foundry GTM content

scripts.render:linkedin: remotion render src/Root.tsx LinkedInPost --props='{"topic":"Enterprise AI Foundry","duration":30}'
scripts.render:youtube: remotion render src/Root.tsx YouTubeIntro --props='{"topic":"Enterprise AI Foundry","duration":60}'
scripts.render:all: npm run render:linkedin && npm run render:youtube
scripts.lambda-create: remotion lambda sites create && remotion lambda function create
